---
title: "Robustness"
subtitle: "Alternative construction assumptions and structural sensitivity"
---



## Robustness philosophy

A composite index should not depend excessively on:

- one indicator;
- one dimension;
- one normalization method;
- one weighting scheme;
- one context-dependent economic sign.

The project therefore evaluates several distinct classes of
sensitivity.

## Alternative specifications

The methodological specifications include:

1. baseline equal weights;
2. alternative dimensional weights;
3. global PCA;
4. internal PCA;
5. median/MAD robust standardization.

## Narrow liquidity/funding benchmark


::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
                  benchmark pearson_vs_icvlf_integral
1 Liquidez + Fondeo (50/50)                 0.4229421
  spearman_vs_icvlf_integral
1                 0.02499118
                                                                                                                           lectura
1 Benchmark de constructo estrecho; una correlación menor no es un fallo de robustez, porque elimina Activos, Cartera y Solvencia.
```


:::
:::


::: {.callout-important}

The liquidity + funding 50/50 benchmark changes the construct itself.

A lower correlation with the full ICVLF should therefore not
automatically be interpreted as failure of robustness.

:::
